_note: S5 (challenge M3, P-119): the six built-in starting person roles, created with the workspace and kept by Reset (founder, P-108 note). Every value is Sample until the immigration expert confirms. The migration 20261027160000_s5_person_roles inserts the same rows for workspaces that already exist; tests/check_s5_slice1.ts checks they agree.

roles.label: Principal applicant
roles.meaning: The person the application is about; exactly one on every case.

roles.label: Spouse or partner
roles.meaning: The principal applicant's spouse or common-law partner, when they are on the case.

roles.label: Child
roles.meaning: A dependent child of the principal applicant; under 18 the principal answers for them.

roles.label: Sponsor
roles.meaning: The person in Canada who sponsors the principal applicant; on the case, never an applicant.

roles.label: Representative
roles.meaning: The person who represents the applicants (IMM 5476); on the case, never an applicant.

roles.label: Parent
roles.meaning: A parent named on a form (for example IMM 5707); described on forms only, never a person on the case.
